description: This file defines registry and configuration for invoke commands and node capabilities within the OpenClaw Android app, including command specifications, capability manifest, and associated metadata.

classes.name: NodeRuntimeFlags
classes.description: Data class representing various runtime feature flags related to device capabilities such as camera, location, SMS, call logs, motion sensors, and build type.

classes.name: InvokeCommandAvailability
classes.description: Enum class specifying availability conditions for invoke commands, such as always available or conditioned on specific device features enabled.

classes.name: NodeCapabilityAvailability
classes.description: Enum class defining availability conditions for node capabilities, like always available or dependent on specific features being enabled.

classes.name: NodeCapabilitySpec
classes.description: Data class defining a node capability's name and its availability condition.

classes.name: InvokeCommandSpec
classes.description: Data class defining an invoke command's name, whether it requires foreground execution, and its availability condition.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Retrieve the invoke command specification by its command string.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities
methods.description: Return a list of capability names that are advertised/enabled based on the current runtime flags.

methods.name: advertisedCommands
methods.description: Return a list of command names that are available/enabled based on current runtime flags.
